bugs.detail: The bot asked 'para quién es el servicio / es para ti' three times total (turns 1, 6, 10) even though the customer answered correctly at turns 2 and 7. Root cause: the LLM verbally acknowledged the answer each time ('Perfecto, para ti entonces') but did not carry the 'audience' value into update_booking/check_availability tool arguments, which stayed null until the customer's third confirmation in turn 11 ('para una mujer adulta'). This is a context_loss / redundant_question defect worth investigating in the audience-resolution logic of update_booking / dynamic prompt assembly.
